title: R1250RT Luxury Tourer
description: Representing BMW Motorrad's prowess in the Luxury Grand Tourer class, the BMW Motorrad R1250RT Luxury Tourer is tuned for uncompromising circuit performance with laser-guided cornering stability. A 1250cc powerplant pumps out 150 HP and 120 Nm of torque, striking an optimal balance between fuel economy and spirited passing power. With a balanced 790mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort and a comfortable Aggressive Forward Tuck layout, it offers fatigue-free ergonomics whether carving traffic or cruising the open highway.
